why: Continue asks for a FRESH run. The most destructive single-token defect in this issue: a player resuming a campaign at level 8 silently has their run replaced with a level-one one, and the persistence write happens at the start boundary before anything is on screen to warn them. Both intents land on a playable campaign board, so nothing about the transition looks wrong. 1 of 25 -- 'Continue asks for the active campaign run'. The New Game case asserts the value this mutation hardcodes and keeps passing, which is the pair that makes either assertion mean anything.
